summary_en: AlbaLink established a dividend policy targeting a 10% payout ratio and announced an initial dividend of 16.00 yen per share for the fiscal year ending December 2026, effective from this period onward.
title_en: Notice Regarding Establishment of Dividend Policy and Dividend Forecast (Initial Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
AlbaLink announced the establishment of a dividend policy and the implementation of its first dividend payment. The company declared a year-end dividend of 16.00 yen per share for the fiscal year ending December 2026, with an effective date from this period onward.

The dividend policy targets a payout ratio of approximately 10%, with the aim of providing stable and continuous dividends while balancing business growth investments and financial soundness. The company noted that since its founding, it had retained earnings to strengthen its financial position and fund business expansion including store openings and advertising. However, with fiscal 2026 expected to deliver substantial growth—sales of 12,439 million yen (up 51.9% year-over-year) and net income of 1,400 million yen (up 42.6%)—the company determined it had reached a stage where it could pursue both growth investments and enhanced shareholder returns.

The year-end dividend for fiscal 2026 will be resolved at the Board of Directors meeting scheduled for February 2027 and is based on the number of shares before a planned 2-for-1 stock split effective January 1, 2027.
